en-US.name: YouEnjoyMyFamily
en-US.summary: Family tasks, schedule, and grocery cart, hands-free.
en-US.description: YouEnjoyMyFamily brings your family's chores, schedule, school sheet and grocery cart to your Echo Show. Say "Alexa, open You Enjoy My Family" and the full family screen opens on the device — no browser, no bookmark. You can also just ask: what's on today's schedule, what's on at school, what chores are left, or add something to the list.
examplePhrases: Alexa, open You Enjoy My Family
Alexa, ask You Enjoy My Family what's on at school
Alexa, ask You Enjoy My Family what chores are left
